review.name: Moonwell Leviathan
findings: Original twelve raw head/body slices and all 216 native actual technique frames inspected. Lower jaw and crescent distort with movement; partial filament masks create fresh bends. V7 includes the complete independently mapped white filament surface: all twelve candidate raw slices and 216 native technique frames inspected and accepted. Nine frozen face/crescent/filament patches pass 644 clip poses plus 468 blends; full geometry passes 203 poses with zero warnings. Rebuilt source/battle repeat review pending.

Final separate second pass inspected all 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing idle frames, 216 actual technique frames in twelve native strips and all sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Nine independently selected face/crescent/filament patches pass 644 clip poses and 468 blends in both assets; 203 full-geometry poses per asset have zero warnings. Sculpt, topology, UVs, textures, all bone frames and every authored animation curve are conserved; 7390 vertex palettes outside the explicit face/filament selection remain exact. Final white-filament coverage is 331 vertices from fifteen original UV islands plus near seam copies. The embedded recipe finding still describes rejected V5 four-island work; V7 adds the hidden reverse surface, documented by the retained original overlay and full-geometry report. Eleven regression/animation-bank checks and production build pass. Whole-roster and live release pending.
